attach.controller: Press Y on a prop and pick Attach. Then press Y on what it goes on and pick Attach To This. Hold RT on an attached prop to move it on its parent.

detach.label: Detach
detach.keyboard: Ctrl+click an attached prop and pick Detach, or select it and press Backspace. On a parent, Backspace detaches everything on it.
detach.controller: Press Y on an attached prop and pick Detach. On a parent, Detach Attached lets go of everything on it.

scene.label: Scene
scene.all: Pick anything in Scene to edit it from the menu, even with the editor closed.

copies.label: Copies
copies.all: Copy To Parent copies a prop onto the same parent. Copy As Child attaches the copy to the prop.

mapentities.label: Map Entities
mapentities.all: Cars and props already in the world join the scene when you move or attach them.

copypaste.label: Copy And Paste
copypaste.keyboard: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X, and Ctrl+V copy, cut, and paste. Delete removes the selection. Ctrl+click has the same options, plus Duplicate and Paste Here.
copypaste.controller: Press Y on anything to copy, cut, paste, duplicate, or delete it.

save.label: Save
save.all: Save the scene from Saved Scenes, or one prop and its attachments with Save As.

undo.label: Undo
undo.keyboard: Ctrl+Z to undo and Ctrl+Y to redo.
undo.controller: Undo and Redo are on the World Editor page.

hints.detach: {key} to detach. Carry it to move it on the parent.
hints.options: {key} it to attach, copy, and more.
hints.release: {key} lets go of everything attached to it.
hints.attachhere: {key} what it goes on, then pick Attach To This.
hints.paddetach: Press {key} on it and pick Detach. Carry it to move it on the parent.
hints.padoptions: Press {key} on it to attach, copy, and more.
hints.padrelease: Press {key} on it and pick Detach Attached to let everything go.
hints.padattachhere: Aim at what it goes on, press {key}, then pick Attach To This.
hints.notinscene: Not in Scene yet. Moving it adds it.

bound.label: Bound Hotkeys
bound.tip: Every option that has a hotkey.
bound.nonetip: Pick a page under Hotkeys to bind one.

clearall.label: Clear All Hotkeys
clearall.tip: Hold to remove every option hotkey. The menu key stays.

tips.toggle: Set a key that turns {name} on or off.
tips.slider: Set a key that turns {name} on or off at its set value.

info.menuonly: Uses only menu keys, so it works while the menu is closed.

notes.savehere: Save where you're standing under a numbered name.
notes.addeddies: Add the eddies amount set on the Items page.

bindpopup.title: Bind Hotkey
bindpopup.hints: Del clears the keyboard key. View clears the controller button. Esc cancels.

clearall.label: Clear All Trainer Effects
clearall.tip: Hold to remove every effect and turn off its option.

none.label: No trainer effects are active.
none.tip: Effects show up here while an option applies them.

row.tip: Remove this effect and turn off {name}.
row.returntip: Remove this effect until the trainer applies it again.
row.weathertip: Give the weather back to the game.

info.turnsoff: Removing it also turns off this option.
info.mayreturn: No option owns this effect, so it may come back.
info.weathernote: Removing it hands the weather back to the game.

noclip.title: NoClip
noclip.tip: Fly through walls and change how NoClip handles.

enabled.label: NoClip
enabled.tip: Fly through walls. Scroll the mouse wheel while flying to change speed.

boost.label: Boost Speed
boost.tip: Speed multiplier while holding Shift or L3.

followcamera.label: Fly Where You Look
followcamera.tip: Look up or down to climb or dive as you fly forward.

forward.label: Forward
forward.tip: Fly forward. The left stick also works.

back.label: Back
back.tip: Fly backward. The left stick also works.

left.label: Left
left.tip: Fly left. The left stick also works.

right.label: Right
right.tip: Fly right. The left stick also works.

boost.label: Boost
boost.tip: Hold to fly at boost speed.

resetcontrols.label: Reset Controls
resetcontrols.tip: Put every NoClip control back to its default.

undetectable.label: Undetectable
undetectable.tip: Enemies can't spot you until you attack them.

loseenemies.label: Lose Enemies
loseenemies.tip: Every enemy fighting you drops combat.

infinitestamina.label: Infinite Stamina
infinitestamina.tip: Sprint, dodge and attack without using stamina.

infiniteoxygen.label: Infinite Oxygen
infiniteoxygen.tip: Stay underwater without running out of air.

superspeed.label: Super Speed
superspeed.tip: Move and act faster than the world around you.

runspeed.label: Run Speed
runspeed.tip: Multiply how fast you walk and run.

infinitejumps.label: Infinite Jumps
infinitejumps.tip: Jump again in midair as often as you like.

wantedlevel.label: Wanted Level
wantedlevel.tip: Set your wanted level. Turn it on to hold it there.

clearwanted.label: Clear Wanted Level
clearwanted.tip: Drop your wanted level and send the police away.

fullrestore.label: Full Restore
fullrestore.tip: Refill health, stamina, RAM and oxygen.

clearstatuseffects.label: Clear Status Effects
clearstatuseffects.tip: Remove bleeding, burning, poison, shock and other ailments.

nofalldamage.label: No Fall Damage
nofalldamage.tip: Land from any height without a hard landing.

armor.label: Armor
armor.tip: Add armor to cut incoming damage.

quicksilver.label: Quicksilver Sandevistan
quicksilver.tip: Your Sandevistan slows time much further and never runs out.

refillram.label: Refill RAM
refillram.tip: Keep your cyberdeck RAM topped up.

invisibility.label: Invisibility
invisibility.tip: Stay cloaked with optical camo while this is on.

lowtrace.label: Low Trace
lowtrace.tip: Enemy netrunners take ten times longer to trace you.

extraram.label: Extra RAM
extraram.tip: Add RAM to your cyberdeck. The RAM bar grows one cell per point.

quickhackcost.label: Quickhack Cost
quickhackcost.tip: Cut the RAM every quickhack costs. 100% makes them free.

fasteruploads.label: Faster Uploads
fasteruploads.tip: Cut quickhack upload time. 100% uploads instantly.

quickhackspread.label: Quickhack Spread
quickhackspread.tip: Quickhacks that can spread jump to this many more enemies.

opticalcamo.label: Optical Camo
opticalcamo.tip: Optical camo stays charged and never runs out.

sandevistan.label: Sandevistan
sandevistan.tip: Sandevistan stays charged with no cooldown.

berserk.label: Berserk
berserk.tip: Berserk stays charged with no cooldown.

overclock.label: Overclock
overclock.tip: Overclock stays charged and never runs out.

airthrusters.label: Air Thrusters
airthrusters.tip: Hold jump in midair to slow your fall.

airhover.label: Air Hover
airhover.tip: Hover in midair after a jump.

opticalcamoduration.label: Optical Camo Duration
opticalcamoduration.tip: Multiply how long optical camo lasts.

kerenzikovduration.label: Kerenzikov Duration
kerenzikovduration.tip: Multiply how long Kerenzikov slows time.

dodgechance.label: Dodge Chance
dodgechance.tip: Chance for an enemy hit to miss you.

elementalresistance.label: Elemental Resistance
elementalresistance.tip: Cut fire, chemical and shock damage.

detectionspeed.label: Detection Speed
detectionspeed.tip: How fast enemies notice you, compared to normal.

sandevistantimescale.label: Sandevistan Time Scale
sandevistantimescale.tip: Lower values slow time more during Sandevistan.

healthregen.label: Health Regen
healthregen.tip: Regenerate health in and out of combat, with no delay after taking damage.

healthbuffer.label: Health Buffer
healthbuffer.tip: A shield over your health that refills itself.

allresistances.label: All Resistances
allresistances.tip: Cut damage from elements, explosions, melee and damage over time.

settings.title: Settings

theme.label: Theme
theme.tip: Colors and opacity of the menu.

layout.label: Layout
layout.tip: Size, spacing and panels of the menu.

language.label: Language
language.tip: Change the language of the menu.

reset.label: Reset Settings
reset.tip: Hold to restore every setting except the language and hotkeys.

hotkeys.label: Hotkeys
hotkeys.tip: Keys and buttons that run options from anywhere.

blockedcontrols.label: Blocked Controls
blockedcontrols.tip: Game controls the menu blocks while it's open.
blockedcontrols.title: Blocked Controls

movement.label: Movement Keys
movement.tip: Also block W, A, S, D, Space, C, Shift and Ctrl.

mouselook.label: Mouse Look
mouselook.tip: Also stop the mouse from turning the camera.

mousebuttons.label: Mouse Buttons
mousebuttons.tip: Also block left and right click.

leftstick.label: Left Stick
leftstick.tip: Also block movement from the left stick.

rightstick.label: Right Stick
rightstick.tip: Also stop the right stick from turning the camera.

facebuttons.label: X And Y
facebuttons.tip: Also block the X and Y buttons.

info.title: Always Blocked
info.keyboard: Arrow keys, numpad, Enter, Backspace, Delete, F2, X and the menu key.
info.mouse: The wheel, plus clicks and movement while the cursor is on.
info.controller: D-pad, A, B and the menu buttons.
info.typing: Typing or setting a key blocks every key and button.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.tip: Where pop-ups show and how long they stay.
notifications.title: Notifications

auto.label: Auto
auto.tip: The corner across from the menu.

topcenter.label: Top Center
topcenter.tip: The middle of the top edge.

bottomcenter.label: Bottom Center
bottomcenter.tip: The middle of the bottom edge.

duration.label: Duration
duration.tip: How long a notification stays on screen.

settings.savefailed: Couldn't save {file}. Make sure the EasyTrainer folder isn't read-only.

effects.label: Trainer Effects
effects.tip: Everything the trainer is applying right now.

theme.label: Theme
theme.tip: Pick a color theme. Moving through the list previews it.

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.tip: How solid the menu background is.

surface.label: Surface
surface.tip: Page path bar and row hover.

softtext.label: Soft Text
softtext.tip: Values on rows that aren't selected.

mutedtext.label: Muted Text
mutedtext.tip: Section names, hints and the footer.

overlay.label: Overlay
overlay.tip: Tint of the highlight and empty controls.

reset.label: Reset Colors
reset.tip: Go back to the theme's own colors.

nightcity.label: Night City
nightcity.tip: Deep navy with a neon cyan accent.

afterlife.label: Afterlife
afterlife.tip: Dark violet with a magenta accent.

netrunner.label: Netrunner
netrunner.tip: Terminal black with an acid green accent.

badlands.label: Badlands
badlands.tip: Dusty brown with a sunset orange accent.

neon.label: Neon
neon.tip: Deep indigo with a hot pink accent.

monochrome.label: Monochrome
monochrome.tip: Plain greys with a white accent.

david.label: David
david.tip: His yellow jacket with Sandevistan teal.

lucy.label: Lucy
lucy.tip: Midnight purple with her netrunner cyan.

rebecca.label: Rebecca
rebecca.tip: Her mint green hair with pink ink.

talia.label: Talia
talia.tip: Chrome grey with her pink braid.

d.label: D
d.tip: Navy with the red of his scar.

kingsley.label: Kingsley
kingsley.tip: Smoky brown with his blonde gold.

roman.label: Roman
roman.tip: Tape black with his green eyes and blonde hair.

scale.label: Menu Scale
scale.tip: Turn on to set the size yourself. Off follows your resolution.

rounding.label: Corner Rounding
rounding.tip: Roundness of the menu and highlight corners.

submenubar.label: Page Path
submenubar.tip: Show the page path under the header.

controlsbar.label: Controls Bar
controlsbar.tip: Show the keys for the current device under the menu.

tipbox.label: Tips
tipbox.tip: Show a tip for the selected row.

infopanel.label: Info Panel
infopanel.tip: Show details for the selected row beside the menu.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.tip: Show pop-ups when actions finish or need your attention.

keyhints.label: Key Hints
keyhints.tip: Show the key to press on the selected row.

edgefade.label: Edge Fade
edgefade.tip: Fade rows at the edges when there's more to scroll.

orbit.label: Orbit
orbit.tip: A dot that grows a ring when on.

light.label: Light
light.tip: A small light that glows when on.

chevron.label: Chevron
chevron.tip: The value with arrows and an underline.

ring.label: Ring
ring.tip: A ring that fills as the value goes up.

track.label: Track
track.tip: A thin bar along the bottom of the row.

togglemenu.label: Toggle Menu
togglemenu.tip: Keys or buttons that open and close the menu.

blockgame.label: Block Game Controls
blockgame.tip: Stop the menu's keys and buttons from reaching the game.

hoverselects.label: Hover Selects
hoverselects.tip: Moving the cursor over a row selects it.

cursorlessclicks.label: Click Without Cursor
cursorlessclicks.tip: Left click selects even when the cursor is hidden.

rightclickback.label: Right Click Back
rightclickback.tip: Right click goes back a page.

wheelscrolls.label: Wheel Scrolls Menu
wheelscrolls.tip: The mouse wheel moves the selection.

repeatdelay.label: Repeat Delay
repeatdelay.tip: How long to hold a key before it repeats.

repeatrate.label: Repeat Interval
repeatrate.tip: Time between repeats while a key is held.

scrollsmoothing.label: Scroll Smoothing
scrollsmoothing.tip: How long scrolling takes to settle.

highlightsmoothing.label: Highlight Smoothing
highlightsmoothing.tip: How long the highlight takes to reach a row.

accelthreshold.label: Acceleration Delay
accelthreshold.tip: How long to hold up or down before scrolling speeds up.

accelstep.label: Acceleration Step
accelstep.tip: How much faster each repeat gets once scrolling speeds up.

fastestrate.label: Fastest Interval
fastestrate.tip: The shortest time between repeats while scrolling.

trainer.label: EasyTrainer
trainer.tip: A Cyberpunk 2077 trainer for keyboard, controller and mouse.

locations.label: Teleport Locations
locations.tip: The hand-picked teleport locations come from LocationKingGRP.

languagemenu.title: Language
languagemenu.label: Select Language
languagemenu.onlyone: Only English is installed. Add another JSON language pack and refresh this list.
languagemenu.loadfailed: That language file could not be loaded. English is still available as a fallback.
languagemenu.savefailed: The language changed for this session, but the preference could not be saved.

reload.label: Refresh Languages
reload.tip: Refreshes the available language list to include newly added files.

redscript.label: Redscript
redscript.tip: Loads EasyTrainer's scripts. Keys and controller input need it.

inputhandler.label: Input Handler
inputhandler.tip: The RED4ext plugin that reads keys, mouse and controller.

utility.label: Utility Plugin
utility.tip: The RED4ext plugin behind the vehicle spawner, World Editor and weather.

inputblocking.label: Input Blocking
inputblocking.tip: Stops the menu's keys and buttons from reaching the game.
